test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2022: Official Paper (Held On: 17 March, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
The bar graph given below shows the cost price and selling price of four articles J, K, L and M.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0eb2f565bf9ab9b1073bd56022ed0ad9d50b4231a08a87ca46dea00740eeec62.png] 

The average cost price of J and K together is how much percent more than the average selling price of L and M together?
solution: **Calculation:** The average cost price of J and K together = (700 + 900)/2 = 800 The average selling price of L and M together = (600 + 800)/2 = 700 Difference = 800 - 700 = 100 Percentage = 100/700 × 100 = 14.28%
